# AI disclosure

This repository was written by an AI agent, not by a human typing code. This file records
what that means concretely so users and downstream packagers can judge it.

## What was generated by AI

Everything in this repository:

- `index.js` and all of `lib/` — the runtime, the rules, and the persistence layer
- `test/smoke.mjs` — the offline checks
- `package.json`, `cordis.patch.yml`, `locale/` — packaging and display metadata
- `README.md`, `docs/DETAIL.md`, and this file
- `icon.svg`

## How

- Agent: a DeepSeek Harness session, root agent, using the `deepseek-flash` model.
- Date: 2026-11-19.
- The human directed the task, chose the mechanisms to port, approved installing the plugin
  into their own profile, and chose the license. The AI wrote the code, ran the tests, and
  reported results.

## What was **not** done

- No source code was copied from the upstream project
  ([microsoft/TokenEconomizer](https://github.com/microsoft/TokenEconomizer)). Its `README.md`
  was read to learn the three mechanisms and their thresholds; the implementation here is
  independent and targets different APIs (DSH's plugin surface rather than another agent's
  hook contract). Upstream is MIT licensed; this work is MPL-2.0, and no upstream code is
  present to relicense.
- No upstream test suite, fixture, or data file was copied.

## What was actually verified

Claims in the README that were checked, and how:

| Claim | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Failure signatures normalize correctly | offline checks in `test/smoke.mjs`, including a Chinese PowerShell message |
| A stale fact is marked, not silently trusted | offline checks for `isStale`/`renderFacts` and the ledger cap |
| `status` prints thresholds and seen signatures | offline check against the rendered status text |
| A fact needs three sessions to be injected | offline check, plus the code path in `lib/facts.js` |
| A confirmed fact is dropped after two contradictions | offline check |
| Loop guard redirects once at the threshold and never interrupts | triggered live: three identical failing tool calls in one turn produced one injected note |
| Facts persist to disk and are injected at session start | observed live: state file written, then the fact appeared in a later session's system prompt |
| Shell non-zero exits count as failures | offline check against the `[exit code: N]` marker DSH emits |

Offline checks in `test/smoke.mjs`: 23, all passing (`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 node test/smoke.mjs`).

Not verified: the `agent/created` tool snapshot and `turn/end` flushing need several real
sessions of use before their output is meaningful. Treat the tool-pruning numbers as
unproven.

## If you contribute

State AI assistance in your commit message. A trailer works:

```
Assisted-by: <agent or model name>
```

Please do not present AI-generated code in this repository as human-reviewed unless it
actually was.
